label: Sixth-edition aphorisms
title: Aphorism § 164
text:
§ 164



The small number of homoeopathic symptoms present in the best selected
          medicine is no obstacle to the cure in cases where these few medicinal symptoms are
          chiefly of an uncommon kind and such as are peculiarly distinctive (characteristic) of the
          disease; the cure takes place under such circumstances without any particular disturbance.
